definitions.explanation: A patty of ground meat served without a bun, typically with sauce.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ハンバーグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate hamburger steak for lunch.

ハンバーグ⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I'll have the hamburger steak set meal.

notes:
ハンバーグ refers to a hamburger steak — a ground meat patty served on a plate without a bun. From German "Hamburg" (steak). It is a staple of Japanese home cooking and family restaurants.

IMPORTANT DISTINCTION:
- ハンバーグ: hamburger steak (no bun, served on a plate with sauce)
- ⟦ハンバーガー→ハンバーガー：27967_hanbaagaa⟧: hamburger (with a bun, fast food style)
This distinction is consistent in Japanese and important for learners to remember.

COMMON VARIETIES:
- ⟦{煮込|にこ}み→煮込み：19761_nikomi⟧ハンバーグ: stewed hamburger steak (in demi-glace sauce)
- ⟦{和風|わふう}→和風：12034_wafuu⟧ハンバーグ: Japanese-style (with grated daikon, ponzu, etc.)
- ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧ハンバーグ: tofu hamburger steak (healthier variation)
- ⟦チーズ→チーズ：00026_chiizu⟧ハンバーグ: cheese-topped hamburger steak

CULTURE:
ハンバーグ is one of the most popular home-cooked dishes in Japan and a children's favorite. It is also a standard menu item at ⟦ファミレス→ファミレス：11141_famiresu⟧ (family restaurants).
